_source: REAL. Every word, as [text, x0, x1, top, bold] pdfplumber's extract_words() finds on each of the 7 pages of the Georgia Secretary of State's 'PROPOSED CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENTS GENERAL ELECTION NOVEMBER 3, 2026' booklet (PDF created 2026-09-14 by Acrobat PDFMaker, 152,039 bytes), unedited. The official copy (https://sos.ga.gov/sites/default/files/2026-09/2026%20Constitutional%20Summaries%20booklet%20FINAL.pdf) answered this environment with a Cloudflare challenge, and web.archive.org was refused by its egress policy; the same file was fetched 2026-09-28 from https://www.augustaga.gov/DocumentCenter/View/21852/2026-Constitutional-Summaries-booklet-FINAL, where Augusta-Richmond County republishes the Secretary's booklet.
